answer: Against a 2019 baseline, Sanofi targets absolute Scope 1 and 2 reductions of 55% and Scope 3 reductions of 30% by 2030, followed by at least 90% across Scopes 1, 2 and 3 by 2045. The near-term Scope 3 boundary covers categories 1–7 listed in the report. SBTi validated the 2030 Scope 1 and 2 and 2045 net-zero targets in 2023, but after the 2025 Opella divestment Sanofi began recalculation and resubmission for revalidation in 2026. It plans community-focused projects to match residual emissions from 2030 and permanent removals from 2045. Reported 2025 progress was 49.4% below the 2019 baseline for market-based Scopes 1 and 2 and 13.7% below baseline for significant Scope 3.
